inputBendsValues.interpretation: KFACTOR and FIT_THICK carry the CAESAR unset sentinel for every governed bend and WI_FACTOR is unset; there is no explicit bend-flexibility, fitting-thickness or weld-factor override to consume.

authorityNotes.KFACTOR: CAESAR neutral-file/help authority identifies this as the user bend flexibility K-factor override. When unset, code/B31J calculation governs.
authorityNotes.FIT_THICK: CAESAR uses a populated fitting thickness only for the curved elbow portion and bases flexibility/SIF calculations on that elbow wall thickness.
authorityNotes.catalogBoundary: The schema catalog inspected table and column authority. Bend values above come from the exact pinned INPUT_BENDS export already used by the governed benchmark evidence.

decision.reason: The pinned ACCDB contains no populated bend flexibility/thickness override and no separate load-case/configuration input table from which a missing elbow-stiffening setting can be recovered. External CAESAR configuration authority remains separate from the ACCDB.
decision.nextInvestigation: Curved-bend member formulation. The diagnostic bend-arc shear candidate strongly aligns with the CAESAR-required correction, but production promotion remains blocked until the curved-bend compliance is justified independently of benchmark fitting.
